Iris Germanica.



Blue Garden Iris. (Rhizome also used to make Orris-root.). N. O.
        Iridaceæ. Tincture of fresh rhizome.



Clinical. ─   Diarrhœa. Dropsy. Freckles.



Characteristics. ─   The fresh root of   Ir. German., I. Flor  ., and our common yellow Iris  , I. Pseudo-acorus  , have been much used in dropsies and are
        violently cathartic. The juice is also used for the removal of freckles from the skin.
